name: dwarven_soldier_runes
description: a Runed Dwarven Soldier, a short stocky dwarf in bronze-and-gold plate armour and a full rounded bronze helmet with cheek guards, a long dark-grey beard, bronze gauntlets and boots, a steel double-bladed battle axe on a short wooden haft in his LEFT hand on the screen-right side, and a big round stone-grey shield with a bronze rim and a glowing orange rune on his RIGHT arm on the screen-left side
hands: the battle axe stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and the round rune shield on his right arm on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-right, the battle axe is lifted beside the head with its double blade pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the axe hand behind the head and the axe head hanging down behind the shoulders to the right, the round rune shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-left, the torso whips round, the axe arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the axe is level, its head pointing to the left
strike.4: contact: axe arm fully extended toward the lower-left, the steel axe head chopping down-left, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the shield arm swung back behind the shoulders for balance with the round rune shield still on it
strike.5: follow-through: the axe carries on down until its head nearly touches the ground at the lower-left, torso twisted, beard swinging back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the axe comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, the round rune shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-left; helmeted head snaps back toward the upper-right, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (axe arm thrown up and out to the right, the round rune shield flung out to the left)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-right, knees bent, the battle axe dipping, the round rune shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-right, body thrown back, axe arm flung up, the round rune shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, helmeted head droops, the battle axe lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the axe head resting on the ground at the lower-left, the shield arm hanging with the round rune shield
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-right, the battle axe slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-left and head toward the upper-right; the battle axe lies on the ground at the lower-left; the round rune shield lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the round shield rocks
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, beard on his chest, the battle axe and the round rune shield on the ground beside him
